_doc: Pixel-coord map for AoE3 DE Skirmish lobby at 1920x1080. Empirically verified 2026-04-28 against game v100.15.59076.0 P2 with Legendary Leaders AI mod. Use with lobby_driver.py. 2026-05-07: skirmish_button shifted from y=488 (now Multiplayer) to y=482 after a content patch added a row.

lobby._opponent_pickers_doc: Civ picker buttons for AI slots P2..P8. P1 is at y=170; in_game_driver.py empirically measured P2/P3/P4 at y=276/382/488 (106px row spacing). P5..P8 extrapolated with the same delta — verified-good coords if the lobby has 8 player rows visible (FFA 1v7 default). x=630 matches p1_civ_picker. Used by matrix_runner --opponent-civs to test up to 8 civs per match.

civ_picker._doc: Opened by clicking lobby.p1_civ_picker. List shows 10 civs at a time, alphabetical. Wheel-down at scroll_anchor scrolls ~0.74 rows per click (use picker_scroll_table.json for accurate scroll counts). Row centers Y=301, 365, 428, 494, 558, 622, 685, 751, 814, 877 (Δ≈64). (Calibrated 2026-05-08 against the SELECT HOME CITY picker; SELECT CIVILIZATION picker has different layout — see PATH_B_NOTES.md.)
civ_picker._leader_name_crop_doc: Crop region used to OCR each picker row's leader/civ-name text. Per-row crop is derived as (x0, y_center+y0_off, x1, y_center+y1_off) where y_center = row_y_start + row*row_spacing. Empirically tuned 2026-05-08 (live game, ANWBritish probe). x0=180 starts AFTER the leader flag/portrait icon (those bleed garbage into OCR if included). y0_off=-25/+25 keeps inside the highlighted-row band without catching adjacent rows. The OCR helper itself does 4x upscale + grayscale on the resulting crop to make tesseract reliable on the small Trajan caps.
civ_picker._opp_leader_name_crop_doc: Crop region for verifying opponent (P2..P8) civ selection. Same form as leader_name_crop. The opponent picker is the SAME picker overlay as P1 (it opens centred on the screen) so the same crop coords apply.

popups._doc: Y-positions of options in each dropdown popup. The popup typically expands DOWN from the dropdown header. X-center may differ from header x because popups can flow left/right.

diff_thresholds._doc: AE-pixel-count thresholds for state detection. Below noise_floor = same screen. Above significant_change = real UI state change.
